title: Bills of Lading and Transport Documents: returning originals before an issued document is corrected
content:
## Scope

This Bills of Lading and Transport Documents clause applies to a correction of an issued transport document on a tier that requires the originals to be returned before an issued document is corrected. On a tier without that requirement, this clause does not apply.

## Formal clauses

1. When the tier requires originals to be returned for a correction, the correction is applied only after every outstanding original has been returned to the line, so that no originals of the document remain outstanding.
2. The returned originals are recorded as surrendered at the origin office.
3. The corrected document is then issued as the next set, its set number being the previous set number plus one, and that set carries no issuance fee.
4. A correction request whose originals are not returned within the tier's originals return deadline, counted in calendar days from the request, lapses and is withdrawn.

## The sequence, as effects on the record

Correction request on file → every outstanding original returned and recorded as surrendered at the origin office, leaving none outstanding → correction applied → corrected document issued as the next set, without an issuance fee.

## Points of judgement

- **Some originals are back, but not all.** The correction is not yet applied: the clause requires every outstanding original to be returned.
- **Is the corrected set charged an issuance fee?** No. The set number moves on by one and no issuance fee is booked for it.
- **Hypothetical case:** a request is registered and the originals are still not all returned when the tier's return deadline from the request has run. The request lapses and is withdrawn; the particular is not corrected on that request.
- This clause concerns only whether and when the correction may be applied and how the set is renewed; which fee the correction itself carries is decided by the correction fee rules.
